about: Shaft drivers a person can drop onto the canvas with their nameplate filled in. Every row's nameplate validates against the part contract (tests/driver-catalog.test.js). `source` says where each number came from; a number marked typical is not a measurement — replace it from the datasheet of the unit bought. A row with `sharedPart` does not describe the part at all: another package OWNS that real part, and this catalog READS its name, mass, price, source and per-domain block out of the owner's catalog file (animatronics' servo rows; embodied's motor rows, whose KV sets noLoadRpm at this lab's operating point; embodied's bus-servo row, whose jointDrive block sets stallTorqueMnm and noLoadDegPerS), declaring only the block this lab adds (`note` says what that is). Rows used by another package name it in usedBy and a read-only cross-package test keeps the shared numbers equal (tests/shared-parts.test.js).

drivers.name: Generic 12 V brushed DC motor
drivers.source: the lab's own default DC motor (the contract defaults): a mid-size hobby motor, typical values, not a measurement

drivers.note: this lab solves it at 14.8 V (4S nominal), so noLoadRpm is the owner's KV x 14.8 V and Ke follows from that KV (60 / (2 pi KV)); the 0.06 ohm winding (stall 247 A at 14.8 V), 1 A no-load, 20 uH and 3 g cm2 are typical 2306 values, not measured. Solved as its DC equivalent behind an ESC.

this lab solves it at 22.2 V (6S nominal), so noLoadRpm is the owner's KV x 22.2 V and Ke follows from that KV (60 / (2 pi KV)); the 0.08 ohm winding (stall 278 A at 22.2 V), 1.2 A no-load, 30 uH and 6 g cm2 are typical 2807 values, not measured. Solved as its DC equivalent behind an ESC.
the 5 V operating point the solver runs it at and the 500 g cm2 reflected rotor inertia are this lab's modelling defaults, not datasheet figures

this lab solves the bus servo as its servo part — a position loop on a geared DC motor — with the pulse width standing in for the serial position command (1-2 ms -> 0-360 deg is this lab's mapping, not a feature of the servo). The nameplate is the cored brushed motor seen at the output of the owner's 1:345 gearbox at the 12 V operating point: 2.7 A stall and 0.18 A running with no load are the feetechrc.com product page's figures at 12 V (https://www.feetechrc.com/525603.html, read 2026-10-30: 'stall current 2.7A@12V', 'running current (at no load) 180 mA@12V'), so the winding reads 12 / 2.7 = 4.44 ohm; the 0.05 A idle (holding still, the electronics alone) is a class estimate, not published; the 70000 g cm2 reflected rotor inertia is a class estimate (a 0.6 g cm2 cored rotor behind 1:345, 0.6 x 345^2), not measured. stallTorqueMnm and noLoadDegPerS are the owner's 30 kg cm and 0.222 s per 60 deg.

drivers.name: NEMA 17 stepper (17HS4401 class)
drivers.source: the class's usual sheet: 1.8 deg, 1.7 A, 1.5 ohm, 2.8 mH, 40 N cm holding, 2.2 N cm detent, 54 g cm2 rotor; the damping ratio is the lab's modelling default, not a datasheet figure
